initialization: Runtime writer/recurrent/action/state-head tensors exactly equal to V10 INITIAL perseed, checked before each train; identical new full state_dict across B2/Ours. New result head, no query vocabulary embeddings or GRU.

pilot_positive_signal: All three Ours-minus-B2 differences in CHECK opposing-pair both-correct counts nonnegative, positive mean, and no mean all-cell accuracy decrease. Even a pass is exploratory and does not establish action benefit or paper readiness.
policy_requirements: Preserve native STOP,500 budget and base input contracts. No V11 navigation starts while V10 owns GPU; no claim of navigation benefit from auxiliary readout.
